item.title: OpenRouter 教程：用 Responses API 构建可在 Linux 沙箱验证 bug 的 AI 代码审查脚本 / Build an AI Code Reviewer with OpenRouter
item.description: Code reviewers that only read a Git diff have to guess whether a change breaks anything, and their fixes come back as prose you apply by hand. This guide builds a Python reviewer on the OpenRouter Responses API that uploads your changed files into a Linux sandbox, runs checks to confirm each bug, and returns validated patches. A review takes one to four minutes and costs $0.015 to $0.045.（OpenRouter Blog）

item.title: 数字生命卡兹克分享折腾一年的Agent自动化系统架构
item.description: 自媒体作者卡兹克分享自己搭建近一年的Agent自动化系统，核心是把任务起点从人身上移开，由事件触发Agent工作。系统分为自动化中台、Agent执行、CI中台和飞书决策四层：中台用rules.json统一管理事件触发和Agent调度，本地MacMini跑Agent任务，自建CI中台完成审查、检查、合并、发布、核实五步，只在删数据、花钱、改方向等关键决策时通过飞书卡片找作者拍板。（公众号：数字生命卡兹克）

item.title: Claude Code 技巧：任务变难时输入 ultrathink 提升当前回合推理努力 / Claude Code tip: if a task turns out harder than you expected, type ultrathink while Claude is working. It raises the effort for the rest...
item.description: Addy Osmani 分享 Claude Code 技巧：当任务比预期更难时，在 Claude 工作期间输入 ultrathink，可提升该回合剩余部分的推理努力，该功能适用于最新版本的终端。他引用 @dmwlff 的帖子，其中提到 ultrathink 已回归 Claude Code CLI，此前因显得怪异且可能令人困惑曾被关闭。（X：Addy Osmani (@addyosmani)）

item.title: 未来属于每个人：Meta 和 CNIB 合作支持盲人、聋哑人或视力低下的加拿大人 / The Future Is for Everyone: Meta and CNIB Partner to Support Canadians Who Are Blind, Deafblind or Have Low Vision
item.description: We believe the future is for everyone. That’s why Meta is partnering with CNIB – a non-profit founded in 1918 that empowers Canadians impacted by blindness to live their dreams – to help bring the benefit of AI glasses to more Canadians who are blind, Deafblind or have low vision. The goal of the partnership is to help people who are blind, Deafblind or have low vision explore the possibilities of AI wearable technology, and draw on the knowledge, expertise and lived experience of the community （Meta AI / Muse Newsroom）

item.title: 美国白宫科技顾问萨克斯称 Anthropic 可能成为资本主义史上最伟大企业
item.description: 美国白宫科学与技术顾问会议主席戴维·萨克斯在 All-In 播客分析 Anthropic 的 S-1 文件，称其很可能成为资本主义历史上最伟大企业，也可能是回报最高的风险投资项目。（IT之家·人工智能）

item.title: OpenRouter 教程：用 Agent SDK 搭建常驻 AI Agent 监控 Hacker News / How to Build Your Own Always-On AI Agent
item.description: An always-on AI agent wakes up on a schedule, checks something with tools, and reports or acts without you asking. This tutorial builds one in TypeScript with the OpenRouter Agent SDK that watches Hacker News, remembers what it has seen across restarts, stops any run at five cents, and waits for your approval before it posts.（OpenRouter Blog）

item.title: Anthropic IPO 后预计将获较高垃圾级信用评级 / Anthropic expected to receive high ‘junk’ rating from credit agencies following IPO, FT report says
item.description: 据 Financial Times 报道，Anthropic IPO 后预计将获较高的垃圾级信用评级。作为近期 630 亿美元芯片融资交易的锚定投资者，Blackstone 此前曾预计 Anthropic 在 2027 年前获投资级评级，如今预期为 double B 区间，即投机级中的最高档。（TechCrunch：AI（RSS））
